questions.stem: Why is using a catalyst considered a green chemistry principle?

options.text: Catalysts are always made from natural materials
Catalysts lower energy requirements, increase selectivity, reduce waste, and are not consumed in the reaction
Catalysts are cheaper than all other chemicals
Catalysts make reactions produce more heat

questions.explanation: Catalysts support green chemistry because they lower activation energy (reducing energy requirements and CO2 emissions), increase selectivity (fewer unwanted by-products), are used in small amounts and are not consumed (so they generate less waste), and can often be recovered and reused.
